description:
Carry the resolved agent identity as an `Assignee` from resolution through the claim coordinator into lease records.

## Background

`resolve_agent_id` returns `Result<String>` (`crates/jit/src/agent_config.rs:88`) after validating through `Assignee` and discarding the result (`:162`). `ClaimCoordinator::new(paths, locker, worktree_id: String, agent_id: String)` (`storage/claim_coordinator.rs:364`) is called at `commands/claim.rs:245,534,580,634,702` and `commands/mod.rs:732`. `ClaimCoordinator` stores the agent as a `String` (`:268`), as does `Lease.agent_id` (`:37`). Each agent id in this checkout's claims log parses as an `Assignee`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `resolve_agent_id` returns `Assignee`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `ClaimCoordinator`, `Lease` and `ClaimOp` hold the agent as `Assignee`, and system callers pass the named actor constants.
- [hard] REQ-03: A claims-log entry whose agent is not a valid assignee fails to decode with an error naming the field.
- [hard] REQ-04: Claims-log lines are byte-identical before and after.
title: Resolved agent identity is an Assignee
